details.question: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.hyde: PayNow 转账一般免手续费；如涉及海外电汇或多币种账户跨境转账，则按本行收费表收费。

details.question: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.rewritten: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.hyde: For TT to Malaysia, a telegraphic transfer fee plus correspondent bank charges apply. Charges vary by account type and currency; using a multi-currency account may help. Please refer to our Overseas Remittance Fee Schedule for exact rates.

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.rewritten: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.hyde: 汇率按市场行情及本行牌价制定，受币种、金额和渠道（如海外电汇）影响，以交易时系统显示为准。周末及公共假期市场休市，汇率可能不更新或采用周末牌价。

details.question: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.rewritten: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
details.hyde: The extra 3.25% is a foreign currency transaction fee. It applies when your Visa payment is processed in USD or outside Singapore, even if Amazon charges in USD. The fee appears separately on your statement. If you use a multi-currency account, select the USD wallet before payment to avoid conversion charges. Check your card terms for details.
kept: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.rewritten: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.hyde: 日本ATM取现通常收取每笔固定手续费及汇率加点，具体以卡种/多币种账户收费表为准；取款需PIN，部分交易需OTP。
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.rewritten: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.hyde: 请核对日期、商户及币种；该小额 charge 常见为海外电汇/PayNow/FAST/GIRO 手续费、多币种账户兑换费或卡验证预授权。非本人交易请即冻结卡并联系客服。

details.question: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
expected: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
details.rewritten: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
details.hyde: 可以。多数信用卡可通过年度消费额、积分兑换或促销条件申请年费豁免；部分卡首年免年费，后续可经OTP验证于App或客服申请，以审批为准。
kept: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.rewritten: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.hyde: PayNow uses your mobile number/UEN to send instant SGD locally. FAST uses your bank account number for instant SGD transfers. Both are local, real-time, and not for overseas remittances.

details.question: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.rewritten: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.hyde: FAST 转账一般几分钟内到账，多数情况即时到账；实际到账时间视收款银行处理而定。

details.question: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.rewritten: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.hyde: Use Overseas Telegraphic Transfer (SWIFT) via online banking. Add your mum’s beneficiary details, select CNY or her multi-currency account, review charges, then authenticate with PIN/OTP. PayNow/FAST/GIRO are for local transfers only.

details.question: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.rewritten: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.hyde: 请提供：收款户名、多币种账户账号及币种、收款银行名称与地址、SWIFT/BIC。美国汇入请走海外电汇；PayNow/FAST仅限本地转账。

details.question: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.rewritten: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.hyde: Binance cannot be added as a payee because crypto exchanges are not supported for overseas wire, PayNow, FAST or GIRO transfers from your multi-currency account.

details.question: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.rewritten: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.hyde: 可以，但取决于渠道及账户限额。PayNow/FAST 转账 SGD 10,000 通常需 OTP/PIN 验证，并受每日限额约束；跨境请用海外电汇，确认多币种账户余额及费用。

details.question: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.rewritten: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.hyde: Common causes: incorrect beneficiary details (account name/number, SWIFT/IBAN/UEN for PayNow/FAST/GIRO), failed OTP/PIN or limit checks, account restrictions/insufficient funds, unsupported currency in your multi-currency account, or compliance/intermediary-bank checks. Check the return reason and resubmit with verified details.

details.question: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.rewritten: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.hyde: 请登录手机银行/网上银行，进入“卡片管理”选择“激活新卡”，按提示设置PIN并完成OTP验证即可开通。PayNow、FAST可即用；海外电汇、GIRO及多币种账户功能请另行申请开通。

details.question: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.rewritten: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.hyde: Please check your card delivery status in the app. If it still hasn’t arrived after two weeks, call our hotline to request a replacement. Once received, activate it with the OTP and set your PIN.

details.question: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
details.hyde: 您的PIN因连续输错三次已被锁定。请通过手机银行使用OTP验证解锁，或携卡及有效身份证件到柜台重置。
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.rewritten: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.hyde: Please check that overseas card usage is enabled, your available balance is sufficient, and your PIN/OTP is correct. For travel, activate your multi-currency account and set a travel notice in the app.

details.question: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.rewritten: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.hyde: 请留在ATM旁并立即致电本行客服，提供ATM位置、时间及卡号末四位；我们将协助取卡或安排补卡。切勿向他人透露PIN或OTP。

details.question: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.rewritten: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.hyde: No. A replacement card is automatically issued before expiry. Activate it using OTP/PIN; your old card will stop working once the new card is activated. Please ensure your mailing address is up to date.

details.question: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.rewritten: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。您可为太太申请附属卡，须经主卡人授权并提交她的身份证明，可经网上银行（OTP验证）或分行办理，受相关条款约束。

details.question: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.rewritten: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.hyde: Our debit card is issued on Visa, not Mastercard. It supports overseas transactions, PayNow, FAST, GIRO and multi-currency accounts; card transactions may require PIN/OTP.
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.rewritten: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.hyde: At 15, you can open a joint/minor account with a parent or guardian’s consent; a standard sole account is not available. Parent/guardian must sign and provide ID. PayNow/FAST/GIRO, card PIN/OTP, overseas remittance and multi-currency features may be restricted. Please visit a branch.

details.question: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.rewritten: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.hyde: 开户请带有效护照/身份证及地址证明；无Singpass可到分行办理，需额外核验并设置PIN/OTP。多币种账户可同开。

details.question: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.rewritten: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.hyde: Please retake your selfie in good lighting, remove glasses, hats or masks, keep your full face in frame, and follow the on-screen prompts. Ensure the app is updated. If it still fails, contact support; never share your PIN or OTP.

details.question: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.rewritten: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.hyde: 您可通过网上银行或手机银行“个人资料”更新住址，并以PIN/OTP验证；如无法办理，请携有效证件到分行更新。

details.question: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.rewritten: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.hyde: Reset your password via the bank’s website/app using “Forgot Password”, verify with an OTP, then set a new password/PIN. If your account is locked, call our hotline.
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.rewritten: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.hyde: 可通过网银或分行办理储蓄账户销户。请先转出余额，取消PayNow/FAST/GIRO及多币种账户关联，处理海外电汇和未入账交易；办理需OTP/PIN及身份证明。

details.question: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
details.hyde: Yes. You can hold Japanese yen in a multi-currency account. Enable JPY via online banking, then view balances and receive overseas remittances.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 你们可以存比特币吗？
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: 你们可以存比特币吗？
details.hyde: 暂不支持比特币存款或托管。账户仅接受法定货币，可用海外电汇、PayNow、FAST、GIRO存入多币种账户；勿向不明平台提供PIN/OTP。
kept: 多币种账户支持的货币
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.rewritten: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.hyde: 定期存款利率随币种、存期及金额而异。请登录网上银行/手机银行查看多币种账户最新利率，或联系客服；以本行官网公布为准。
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.rewritten: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.hyde: Apply online via our Home Loan application form. Submit income documents, property details and credit assessment consent. Verify with an SMS OTP/PIN. Our mortgage specialist will contact you within 2 business days.

details.question: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.rewritten: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.hyde: 分行一般周一至周五 9:00–16:30 营业，周六部分分行 9:00–12:30，周日及公共假期休息。具体请以官网“分行查询”为准。

details.question: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.rewritten: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.hyde: Travel insurance may be included depending on your card type. Cover generally applies when eligible travel is paid with your card. Please check your card benefits guide for coverage, limits and claims; OTP verification may be required for claims.

details.question: 那 FAST 呢？
details.rewritten: FAST 转账的手续费是多少？
details.hyde: FAST 转账经网上银行或手机银行办理一般免手续费；柜台办理或涉及多币种账户可能另收费，详情以本行收费表为准。

details.question: what if I forgot the PIN?
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: What should I do if I forgot the PIN for my new card?
details.hyde: Please reset your new card PIN via digibank (Card Services > Reset PIN) or at any ATM. An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile. If unsuccessful, call our hotline or visit a branch.
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
